# Evenkeel

> Practical, sourced everyday-preparedness guides for households worldwide. Prepared, not scared.

## Guides

- [How do I build a home emergency food and water stock?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/home-emergency-food-and-water-stock.html): How much water and food to store, how long pantry staples last, and a homemade kit checklist.
- [How do I store drinking water for an emergency?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/store-emergency-drinking-water.html): How much to store, which containers to use, how to clean them and when to replace the water.
- [What should I do during a power cut? A 3-day plan](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/power-cut-plan-3-days.html): What to prepare, what to do during and after, with fridge and freezer times.
- [What should go in a home first aid kit?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/home-first-aid-kit-checklist.html): The Red Cross list of 19 basic items, personal additions and how to maintain the kit.
- [What should I pack in a go bag to leave home fast?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/go-bag-checklist-leave-home-fast.html): What to pack to leave home fast: clothes, water, documents, medicines, cash and chargers.
- [How do I stay safe at home during a heat wave?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/heat-wave-safety-at-home.html): CDC-based heat steps: water, cooling, clothing, who is at risk, and what to prepare.
- [How do I stay warm and safe in a cold snap or winter power cut?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/cold-snap-and-winter-power-cut-safety.html): CDC-based cold steps: keep warm, avoid carbon monoxide, spot hypothermia and frostbite.
